    input wire start,

);

    reg [15:0] data; // Register to hold the input data

            data <= 0;

            end
        end
    end
endmodule

);

    parameter IDLE = 2'b00, CONNECTING = 2'b01, CONNECTED = 2'b10, DISCONNECTED = 2'b11;

                    if (start) state <= CONNECTING;

                    else if (disconnect) state <= CONNECTING; // Stay in CONNECTING

                CONNECTED: begin
                    if (disconnect) state <= DISCONNECTED;
                end
                DISCONNECTED: begin
                    if (start) state <= CONNECTING;
                end
                default: state <= IDLE; // Fallback to IDLE
            endcase
        end
    end

module non_restoring_divider (
    input [3:0] dividend,
    input [3:0] divisor,
    output reg [3:0] quotient,
    output reg [3:0] remainder
);
    reg [4:0] r; // Remainder and the bit to be shifted in
    reg [4:0] d; // Divisor
    
    integer i;

    always @(*) begin
        r = {1'b0, dividend}; // Initialize remainder
        d = {1'b0, divisor}; // Initialize divisor
        quotient = 4'b0; // Initialize quotient

        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin
            r = r << 1; // Shift left
            r[0] = dividend[3 - i]; // Bring in next bit of dividend
            r = r - d; // Subtract divisor
            if (r[4] == 1) begin
                r = r + d; // If negative, restore
                quotient[i] = 0; // Set quotient bit to 0
            end else begin
                quotient[i] = 1; // Set quotient bit to 1
            end
        end
        remainder = r[3:0]; // Final remainder
    end
endmodule

module dma_controller(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire start,
    input wire rw,       // 0 for read, 1 for write
    input wire [7:0] addr,
    inout wire [7:0] data,
    output reg done
);
    reg [3:0] byte_count;
    reg [7:0] memory [0:255]; // Simple memory model for 256 bytes
    reg [7:0] temp_data;

            byte_count <= 0;
            done <= 0;

            byte_count <= 0;
            done <= 0;

            if (rw) begin // Write operation
                memory[addr + byte_count] <= data; // Write data to memory
            end else begin // Read operation
                temp_data <= memory[addr + byte_count]; // Read data from memory
            end
            byte_count <= byte_count + 1;
        end else begin
            done <= 1; // Indicate transfer is complete
        end
    end

    assign data = (rw) ? 8'bz : temp_data; // Data bus tri-state control
